name: Threat Modeling
purpose: Enumerate trust boundaries, attack vectors, privilege levels, and abuse cases.
inputs: System architecture, data-flow diagram, and trust boundaries
Critical assets, data flows, and attacker-reachable surfaces
Threat actors, abuse cases, and existing security controls
outputs: DFD, trust-boundary map, and STRIDE threat inventory
Prioritized abuse cases with owners and mitigations
Security requirements, residual risks, and re-review trigger
stop_conditions: Every prioritized threat has an owner, mitigation, residual-risk decision, and verification status
